name: Vorgol
note: Artesian drinking-water brand from the Lipetsk region; official supplier of FC Rodina's professional teams and academy since 25 Jul 2026. Ownership check: the brand's official site (vorgolmsk.ru) names OOO «Дабл Блэк» as the brand's exclusive distributor, and the site's public offer, address and contacts are OOO «Дабл Блэк»'s (claim vorgol-dabl-blek-ownership); OOO «Дабл Блэк» is wholly owned by its founder Evgeny Kuprin per the EGRUL registry via checko.ru (claim dabl-blek-kuprin-ownership). No source found identifies the owner of the Vorgol brand itself: the distributor relation does not show OOO «Дабл Блэк» owns the brand, so the ownership field is left unset and the sponsor stays not rated yet. Proposed tier if a maintainer accepts the operator chain as the owner chain: none (see PR).
